An '''exogorth''' was found to be living in the [[Minos Cluster/Legends|Minos Cluster]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. The [[Exogorth/Legends|exogorth]] shed its skin at one point during the conflict, and [[Scientist/Legends|scientists]] were able to acquire pieces of its skin before retreating.
